info.title: notenwart API
info.description:
Sign-in sets an HTTP-only session cookie; every endpoint except `/health` and `/auth/*` needs it and acts on
the signed-in user's organisation. Requests that change something and carry an `Origin` header must come from
the server's own origin.

Roles: **admin** (everything), **librarian** (library and ensembles), **leader** (reads the library, manages
the ensembles they lead), **member** (sees their own parts). A member sees a part when one of their ensembles
has the part's work and they play its instrument there – any part number, or the same one – or when a leader
granted them that part in the ensemble; parts without an instrument (full score, …) are for leaders.

post.summary: Import people from a table (admin)
post.description:
Each row adds a person (or finds an existing one by email) and optionally puts them in an ensemble, playing an
instrument and part number. Missing ensembles are created. Nothing is changed when any row has an error: the
answer is then 422 with the results per row. With `dryRun`, nothing is changed either, and the answer is 200.
New people get an invitation link (emailed when the server can send mail).

422.description: At least one row has an error; nothing was imported.

post.summary: Do one thing to many people at once (admin)
post.description:
One transaction. Changing the role of or deleting yourself is skipped and reported, as are ids that are
not people of the organisation.

schema.description: A file as it is sent or received: any bytes.

pages.description: Strokes by page number ("1", "2", …), in drawing order.

setupRequired.description: The server has no users yet; `/auth/setup` creates the first admin.

mailEnabled.description: The server can send email (sign-in links, invitations).

maxUploadBytes.description: Largest PDF the server accepts in one upload.

sso.description: Name of the identity provider to sign in with, if one is set up.

organization.description: The organisation's name and logo, for the sign-in page.

instrumentId.description: For addToEnsemble – also play this instrument there.

done.description: People the action was applied to.

userId.description: Id of the deleted account (nothing else about the person is kept).

deletedBy.description: Name of the admin who deleted it, while that account exists.

records.description: How many records went with the account, by kind.

logoUrl.description: Path of the logo image, if any.

symbol.description: An emoji shown when there is no logo.

canManage.description: The user may change members and works.

url.description: Only when just created: the link itself (the server keeps only its hash).

role.description:
admin, librarian, leader or member (also German – Admin, Notenverwaltung, Leitung, Mitglied); empty means
member. Ignored for existing people.

instrument.description: Instrument name or alias (English or German, e.g. "Trompete"); needs an ensemble.

voice.description: Part number; empty plays every part of the instrument.

message.description: Why the row cannot be imported (English).

invitationUrl.description: For new people after a real import.

transposition.description: Key the instrument is written in (`Bb`, `Eb`, `F`, …); null for concert pitch.

aliases.description: Other names and abbreviations (any language), used to recognise file names and imports.

usage.description: Parts and member assignments that use the instrument.

sort.description: Omitted for new families means last.
Order within the family; omitted for new instruments means last.

url.description: One-time sign-in link to hand over.

item.description: What was lent, e.g. "Trompete 2" or "complete set".

borrowerId.description: A person of the organisation; their name is taken from the account.

hasPassword.description: False after an invitation until the user sets a password.

avatarUrl.description: Path of the user's picture, if any (and allowed).

password.description: New password; null keeps the current one.

currentPassword.description: Required to change an existing password.

logoUrl.description: Path of the logo image, if any.

symbol.description: An emoji shown when there is no logo.

works.description: Works of the ensemble with at least one part the user may see.

programs.description: Programmes by date, undated last; their works refer to `works`.

updatedAt.description: Changes whenever the part's PDF is rendered again; offline copies compare it.

link.description: A path of the web app.

push.description: Stored already; sending push messages comes later.

instrumentId.description: Null for parts without a single instrument (full score, choir).

voice.description: Part number for instruments with several parts (Clarinet 1, 2, 3).

sourceId.description: A source file of the same work.

pages.description: 1-based page numbers of the source file in the order the part shows them; each page at most once.

PartProposal.description: A run of pages that belong to one part, read from the page headers.

printed.description: The header as printed on its first page ("2. Trompete in B"); none for pages before the first header.

score.description: A score or similar ("Partitur", "Direktion") rather than one instrument.

PersonalData.description:
A self-describing export (account, ensembles, singleParts, annotations, loans, signIns); its fields may grow.
It only describes the answer; the app builds it as JSON.

voice.description: Null plays every part number of the instrument.

workIds.description: The works in playing order (also in `items`).

items.description: Works and breaks in playing order.

ProgramItem.description: One entry of a programme in playing order: a work, or a break (interval, speech).

part.description: The part as printed, e.g. "2. Trompete in B".

clef.description: Only an AI reads the music itself.

ai.description: The external AI added to the result.

RecognitionAbilities.description: What this server can do, found out on start.

ai.description: An external AI reads the page as well (also clef, key and time signature).

instrumentId.description: Practice recordings only, e.g. the voice "Sopran" when all voices share one score.

Role.description: What someone may do in an organisation.

canEdit.description: The user may change this layer (leaders of the ensemble, staff).

width.description: Line width as a fraction of the page width.

points.description: Points as [x, y], each 0 to 1 – 0,0 is the page's top left, 1,1 its bottom right.

mailFrom.description: The sender of emails; none when the server sends none.

ai.description: The external AI reading pages, if any.

storedBytes.description: Uploaded sources, recordings and images; parts are cut from the sources and not counted twice.

manual.description: Ticked by hand rather than recognised.

WorkFacets.description: Values already used on works, most used first, for suggestions while typing.

societyNumber.description: The performing rights society's number of the work (e.g. GEMA-Werknummer).

archiveLocation.description: Where the printed copies are kept, e.g. "Schrank 3, Fach B".

source.description: Where the music comes from or under which licence it is used (free text, for the operator).

Conflict.description: Clashes with existing data, e.g. a name or email that is taken.

Forbidden.description: Signed in, but the role does not allow this.

Invalid.description: The request is well-formed but its content is not acceptable.

NotFound.description: No such object in this organisation.

TooManyRequests.description: Too many attempts; try again later.

Unauthorized.description: Not signed in, or the credentials or token are wrong or expired.
